$comment: Team event log schema. One JSON object per line in the log; every event carries t, seat, event. Fields listed under required must be present; verdict values are closed.

spawn.doc: a seat instance started; tree = {head, dirty}

claim.doc: the seat took a work item, optionally at a named station of a line

check.doc: a declared check ran (deterministic) or was judged (inferential); tree = {head, dirty} binds a receipt to the state it ran against

verdict.doc: one lens's verdict on one item; the disagreement rate is computed over these
